decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management sits right beside the firm's core ship management know-how, so the firm can read market feedback well and adapt the dedicated unit to growing offshore wind demand, which fits its sustainability direction.

Crew and corporate travel management draws directly on the firm's large seafarer pools and crew logistics expertise, so it uses existing knowledge at low marginal cost, even if travel disruption makes it less central.

The online vessel information portal is a flagship that packages the firm's operational data for clients, and its digital lessons can be absorbed through university cooperation, which supports keeping and refining it rather than abandoning it.

The mobile performance app relies on software capabilities further from the firm's service core and may be folded into the portal, but it supports efficiency and emissions monitoring, so management likely keeps it for now.
